mapper.select: SELECT id, organization_id, username, password_hash, display_name, status, must_change_password, password_changed_at, last_login_at, auth_version, created_by, created_at, updated_at, row_version FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT role_code FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{id} ORDER BY role_code
SELECT customer_id FROM sys_user_customer_scope WHERE user_id = #{id} ORDER BY customer_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_organization o ON o.id = u.organization_id JOIN sys_user_role r ON r.user_id = u.id AND r.role_code = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' AND o.organization_type = 'SERVICE_PROVIDER'
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET auth_version = auth_version + 1, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE organization_id = #{id}
mapper.sql: id, organization_id, username, password_hash, display_name, status, must_change_password, password_changed_at, last_login_at, auth_version, created_by, created_at, updated_at, row_version
